thread:
Alex (PM): Quick sync — we need final wording for partner commitment terms in the invite. aim: 6–8 week beta, 1–2 weekly feedback touchpoints, and clear exit criteria.
Maya (Design): Agree on the 6-week minimum. shorter makes it hard to measure impact. recommend weekly UX check-ins + an async survey after each milestone. :white_check_mark:
Kenji (Eng): From infra side, we need a clear traffic cap and SLA expectations. Suggest: max 2k requests/day during beta, and 99th p50 latency target for our baseline model.
Priya (CS): We should spell out support window — CS owns onboarding, but escalation to Eng within 4 hours for production-impacting issues. Also add a playbook link: <https://wiki/redwood/beta-playbook>
Sam (Legal): NDA + data usage note: participants must accept our standard NDA and we need to clarify telemetry collection — acceptable to store prompt hashes + metadata, not raw customer data. I'll share redlined clause.
Alex (PM): Good. Incentives? credits + 1:1 product deep-dive at end. Also consider a referral bonus for successful case studies.
Maya (Design): Need a feedback capture template. I'll paste a short snippet to standardize responses:
```
1) What did you try?
2) What happened vs expected?
3) Severity (S1/S2/S3)
4) Suggested fix or ask
```
Kenji (Eng): Also we should add a health hook: beta clients get a /health endpoint and a weekly health report S3 link. minimal heat metrics: error rate, avg latency, token cost estimate.
Priya (CS): For success criteria, propose: 1) >75% of partners adopt the recommended integration, 2) median latency within 10% of baseline, 3) documented ROI case (token cost reduction or engagement uplift).
Sam (Legal): On data rights: Redwood can use anonymized aggregate feedback to improve models, but partners retain IP of their prompts and configs. Add opt-in for public case studies.
Alex (PM): Scope negotiation question: if a partner requests custom reranking, do we accept as beta work or push to a scoping ticket? Thoughts?
Kenji (Eng): If it's a config change (parameters + model selection) ok. If it's new infra (reranker service), create a scoped eng ticket and timeline — don't promise immediate delivery.
Priya (CS): Flag for prioritization: partner size > $X/mo or strategic partner -> escalate to PD for canary.
Maya (Design): Timeline reminder: recruitment messaging goes live Mon. Need final wording for the invite: commitment, NDAs, feedback cadence, incentives. I'll draft in #marketing after.
Alex (PM): I'll consolidate and send a one-pager for sign-off. ACTIONS: Sam to post NDA redline by EOD, Maya to post invite text by EOD, Kenji to confirm traffic caps and health hooks by EOD, Priya to create the success metric tracker.
oncall-bot: Reminder — create a dedicated channel for each partner: r-dp-<partner-short>, and enable audit logs.
Priya (CS): One more: recommend a 2-week 'cooldown' post-beta where we provide a knowledge-share session and export of their telemetry.
Alex (PM): Great. If no objections I'll publish the invite copy tomorrow morning. :rocket:
Maya (Design): lgtm
Kenji (Eng): +1
Sam (Legal): ack
Priya (CS): 👍
